name: Capacitor Production Line Solution
summary: Full-line automation solutions for capacitor manufacturers, covering winding, assembly, sealing, aging, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The capacitor production line solution is TXAM's full-line automation solution for capacitor manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process including winding, assembly, impregnation, sealing, aging testing, visual inspection, performance testing, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • High-speed precision winding, achieving industry-leading winding accuracy
  • Automated assembly, reducing manual intervention and improving consistency
  • Vacuum impregnation system, ensuring stable insulation performance
  • Intelligent aging testing, greatly improving testing efficiency
  • Vision inspection system, with high defect recognition accuracy
  • Moisture-proof packaging system, ensuring product shelf life

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, to after-sales service.

painPoints.title: High winding accuracy requirements
painPoints.desc: Capacitor winding accuracy requirements are extremely high, making manual operation difficult to guarantee

painPoints.title: Complex assembly processes
painPoints.desc: Capacitor assembly involves multiple precision steps.

painPoints.title: Sealing performance is hard to control
painPoints.desc: Sealing process requirements are strict, and manual operation consistency is poor

painPoints.title: Cumbersome aging tests
painPoints.desc: Aging testing takes a long time, and manual operation efficiency is low

painPoints.title: Appearance inspection is challenging
painPoints.desc: Micro-defects are difficult to detect with the naked eye.

painPoints.title: Strict packaging requirements
painPoints.desc: Capacitors have strict requirements for moisture-proof packaging, etc.
